title: media.failed v1 payload
description: Processing failed; the media is never served. retryable: true for an image the owner may upload again after an outage. For a transcoded video (5.2, additive): kind, purpose and code, the failure code (too_long, hdr_unsupported, dimensions_too_large, no_video_stream, unreadable, unsupported_type, timeout, transcode_failed, too_many_attempts, storage_unavailable, internal); its outputs and original are deleted.
